description: Asks what a Text(255) and a LongText QueryDef parameter does with edge values inside expressions: the values 'a', 'a ', 'a' & U+0000, an odd-byte BSTR of 1 byte, one of 3 bytes, a lone high surrogate, an astral pair, 'ss', the empty string, Null and a fullwidth A are assigned in turn (Value read back) and the QueryDef is opened as a snapshot for SELECT ID FROM Tx WHERE T = p ORDER BY ID, for SELECT ID FROM Tx WHERE M = p ORDER BY ID (LongText) and for SELECT Len(p) AS l, LenB(p) AS lb, p & '' AS c, UCase(p) AS u, Asc(p) AS a FROM One. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
